⚡ About this handbook

ETO Handbook – Marine Electrical Engineering, Guides & Tools – everything an ETO needs, free: 300+ calculators, troubleshooting guides, preventive-maintenance steps and simulators – power, cables, motors, generators, protection, drives, harmonics, jacking, cranes, thrusters, power-plant analysis, plus unit converters, maths, geometry, circuit theory and mechanical / thermal formulas – built for daily work on a jack-up barge. It runs offline in any browser. Calculations follow commonly used IEC / IEEE / IACS practice and are aids only: always verify against the vessel's drawings, equipment nameplates, manufacturer data and class / flag rules. Feedback and suggestions are welcome by email or WhatsApp.
